BiblicalUsage: Trust is the word for confidence, and it appears three times, twice in the same taunt. In 2 Kings 18:19 the Rabshakeh asks Hezekiah, what confidence is this wherein thou trustest? Isaiah 36:4 repeats the question word for word. And Ecclesiastes 9:4 answers from the other side: to him that is joined to all the living there is hope, for a living dog is better than a dead lion.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the Rabshakeh's question is still asked of every believer, and the answer is the same one Hezekiah gave: my confidence is the Lord, and he has not failed yet.
